summary: Decodes a packed 4-byte-per-element vertex/color block to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pointer as this[6] (+0x18) + a3 * this[1045] (+0x1054) + a2 * this[1044] (+0x1050), then loops over this[1046] (+0x1058) elements (4 source bytes each), writing 4 floats per element: first = signed byte 0 * 0.0078125, second = signed byte 1 * 0.0078125, third = 0.0, fourth = unsigned byte 2 * 0.0039215689. If the this[4] (+0x10) flag is set, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float buffer before returning.

operations.description: Compute the source block base pointer: this[6] (+0x18) + a3 * this[1045] (+0x1054) + a2 * this[1044] (+0x1050), selecting the row (a3) and slice (a2) within the source.
Iterate over this[1046] (+0x1058) elements, from v4 to v4 + 4 * this[1046] (4 source bytes per element), writing 4 floats per element; a4 advances by 4 floats per iteration.
Write the first float as (double)v7 * 0.0078125, where v7 = *v4 is the first source byte taken as signed char (scaled by ~1/128); scale constant materialized from read global 0x0059E774.
Write the second float as *(v4 - 3) * 0.0078125, the second source byte taken as signed char (scaled by ~1/128); scale constant materialized from read global 0x0059E774.
Write the third float as 0.0 for every element.
Write the fourth float as *(v4 - 2) * 0.0039215689, the third source byte taken as unsigned char (scaled by ~1/255); scale constant materialized from read global 0x0059E460.
If this[4] (+0x10 flag) is non-zero, run the post-processing pass on the decoded float buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output buffer base), where the base is a4 - 4 * this[1046] floats after the loop, i.e. the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
Return (void); execution ends after the optional post-processing pass.
